title: Geometry
description: Class 3 IMO — Geometry: 2D shapes and their sides and corners, 3D shapes with faces, edges and vertices, types of lines, and basic line symmetry.

topics.title: 2D Shapes
topics.concept:
2D (flat) shapes can be drawn on paper. A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners, a rectangle has 4 sides (two long, two short) and 4 corners, a triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners, and a circle is round with no corners.

The straight edges are sides and the points where they meet are corners (vertices).

examples.problem: How many sides and corners does a square have?
How many sides does a triangle have?

recap: Triangle: 3 sides, 3 corners. Circle: round, no corners.

quiz.q: How many corners does a circle have?
quiz.explanation: A circle is round and has no corners.

quiz.q: How many sides does a rectangle have?

topics.title: 3D Shapes: Faces, Edges, Vertices
topics.concept:
3D (solid) shapes take up space. A cube (like a dice) has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A cuboid (like a brick) also has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A sphere is like a ball, a cylinder like a tin, and a cone like an ice-cream cone.

A face is a flat surface, an edge is where two faces meet, and a vertex is a corner.

examples.problem: How many faces does a cube have?
A dice is the shape of which solid?

recap: Cube and cuboid: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices.
Face = flat surface; edge = where faces meet; vertex = corner.

quiz.q: How many faces does a cuboid have?
A ball is the shape of a ___ ?

topics.title: Lines & Symmetry
topics.concept:
Lines can be straight, curved or slanting. The edge of a ruler is a straight line; the letter S is made of curves.

A shape has line symmetry if a line can divide it into two equal halves that match exactly, like a mirror. That line is called a line of symmetry. A square has 4 lines of symmetry.

examples.problem: What kind of line is the edge of a ruler?
How many lines of symmetry does a square have?

recap: Lines can be straight, curved or slanting.
A line of symmetry splits a shape into two matching halves.

quiz.q: A line that divides a shape into two equal matching halves is called a line of ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Such a line is called a line of symmetry.

quiz.q: What kind of line is the edge of a ruler?
quiz.explanation: A ruler's edge is a straight line.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are 2D shapes)?
questions.explanation: A cube is a 3D (solid) shape; the others are flat 2D shapes.

questions.q: A triangle is to 3 sides as a square is to ___ ?

questions.explanation: A circle is round and has no corners.
The pattern alternates triangle, square — next is a triangle (▲).

questions.q: What is the total number of corners in 2 triangles and 1 square?
questions.explanation: Each triangle has 3 corners (3 + 3 = 6) and a square has 4, so 6 + 4 = 10.
